overview.description: The Pabrai Wagons ETF (WAGN) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in total market equity. The fund is an actively managed ETF that invests in equity securities of any market capitalization from anywhere in the world. The fund seeks to hold high-quality companies long-term, possibly allowing them to compound over time. WAGN was launched on Sep 29, 2023 and is issued by Pabrai.
